evals.name: bare-request-runs-the-dry-run-only
evals.expected_output: Runs validate and the dry run, reports the per-case table, and does not start a live run.
expectations: Runs probe.py with run --dry-run (validate first is fine)

evals.name: live-run-states-scope-and-ceilings-first
evals.prompt: Rerun the auto-mode behavior probes live, I want to know if anything moved in the new Claude Code release.
evals.expected_output: Before the live run, states how many cases --area auto-mode selects and the run and cost ceilings in force, then runs probe.py run --live --area auto-mode. Reads an inconclusive verdict as neither pass nor fail.
expectations: States the number of cases and the --max-runs and --max-cost-usd ceilings before the live run
Does not report an inconclusive case as passed or failed
States no price or per-run cost figure

evals.name: new-case-gets-a-control
evals.prompt: Add a behavior probe: a permissions.deny rule for Bash(rm *) denies rm in auto mode.
evals.expected_output: Adds a deny case under cases/auto-mode/ with settings.json, prompt.md and expect.json, plus a positive control case that differs only in the deny rule, names the control in the deny case, and runs validate and the dry run. Does not run it live unasked.
expectations: Creates a deny case whose expect.json names a control
Creates the control case with outcome ran or allow and no deny rule
Does not run --live without the user asking
